title: JOBifAI: A Free Comedy Visual Novel Where You Sweet-Talk Your Way into a Game Job! (Groq, Replicate)
author: fa_lin

comments.author: fa_lin
comments.body:
In JOBifAI, you applied for a game designer job, but were too drunk to remember your application. An AI made your CV and portfolio, and now you need to convince the company's art director that your portfolio is what they are looking for in their next project.

What makes our game unique?

\- AI-Generated Dialogue: We’ve used Groq (Ollama) for natural language interactions, making conversations with characters feel dynamic and engaging.

\- Innovative Use of Technology: We’ve developed the game using Ren'Py, and we’re incorporating Replicate for image (portfolio) generation, ensuring that every playthrough is full of surprises!

\- Human-Crafted Elements: While the dialogue is AI-generated, all the music, script, and core artwork are 100% man-made!

Future Plans: We’re planning to release the code on GitHub at some point. If you're interested in game development or just love innovative storytelling, we’d love to share our journey with you!

Feel free to ask any questions or share your thoughts!
